title: MACHINES B BAKED
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the sprites, and the frame budget the graphics program keeps: the redrawn Warden, Overseer, Bulwark, Howler and Pillbox painted 34 to 64 shapes each, every frame, for parts that never change. Their still parts are now painted once into a small sprite and stamped in one go, the way the shadows and walls already are, and only what moves stays live: track links and wheels, legs and feet, eyes and glows, the turning shield, the mortar tube, the turning pipe crown and the Pillbox mouth. A Warden now costs about 5 draw calls instead of 54, a Pillbox 15 instead of 53. The pictures are the same. The graphics setting that paints walls live paints these live too.
now: The heavy machines draw from baked sprites: same look, a fraction of the drawing cost.
